prompt.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: a THREE-FRAME limited-animation key-pose SPRITE SHEET of these exact two Song dynasty scholars standing face to face on a field road discussing a hand scroll. TWO reference images. The FIRST shows the exact two people to draw: copy identity, face, hair, clothing colours and carried objects from it. Its camera angle is from slightly above and partly from behind; IGNORE that angle. The SECOND reference is a finished three-cell sheet of a different person: copy ONLY its camera angle (eye-level three-quarter view, the same as every other figure on the street), its figure scale and its three-cell layout. Do NOT copy that person. Keep their identity: the left man wears a dark scholar's cap, a green long robe with cream collar and cuffs, and holds the SAME pale paper hand scroll; the right man wears a dark scholar's cap and a slate blue-grey long robe with a brown sash. The left man faces right, the right man faces left toward him, a small gap between them. Cell 1 (left) = rest: the left man holds the rolled scroll with both hands at chest height, the right man listens with his hands folded in front of him. Cell 2 (middle) = reading: the left man unrolls the scroll a little between both hands and looks down at it, reading aloud; the right man leans slightly toward the scroll to look. Cell 3 (right) = replying: the left man lowers the half-rolled scroll to his waist and looks up; the right man raises his right hand with an open palm, gesturing as he answers, and nods. The feet stay planted on exactly the same spot in all three cells; only the arms, hands, heads and upper bodies move, with believable weight at the hips and knees. Fine ink outlines and muted antique Chinese watercolor exactly matching the first reference, same line weight, same palette, same paper-grain shading. Truly transparent alpha background, no ground shadow, no glow, no grid lines, no numbers, no text. One single horizontal row of 3 equal-width cells, one full group per cell, centered in its cell with generous margin so hands, baskets, scrolls, sleeves and feet never touch a cell edge. Identical character size and identical camera angle in every cell. Redraw at higher detail than the small reference without changing the design. Make every cell match the first reference and match each other as strictly as possible.
